text: AI Voice Sales Agent | Python, LLM, Speech-to-Text (Whisper), Text-to-Speech (Piper) ● Built an end-to-end AI voice sales agent combining Speech-to-Text (Whisper), LLM-based conversational reasoning, and Text- to-Speech (Piper) to automate sales calls. ● Implemented lead qualification logic and AI-generated call summaries, and integrated the agent with a CRM/database layer to persist call outcomes and lead status. INET: Cognitive Image Segmentation | Python, Flask, TensorFlow, OpenCV, NumPy, Pandas, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap ● Built and deployed a Flask-based backend that accepts dermoscopic skin image uploads and returns AI-driven segmentation results through a REST endpoint. ● Handled dataset preprocessing, model integration, and backend-to-frontend data flow end-to-end, with a responsive UI for displaying predictions. Multi-Object Tracking System | Python, Flask, YOLO, OpenCV, TensorFlow, NumPy, Pandas, HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap ● Built a Flask backend with API endpoints that streams real-time object detection/tracking results using YOLO, processing live video frames via OpenCV and visualizing them on a Bootstrap dashboard.
